liz: Quick conductor ping — tomorrow's release train window 09:30-11:30 PT. Need owners for three waves (A: api, B: ingest, C: frontend). Please claim and confirm deploy time + rollback readiness. I'll open a live channel.
omar: I'll take Wave A (api-gateway). Deploy at 09:40 PT. Plan: warmup containers, run post-deploy healthcheck. ETA smoke by 09:48. @sam can you confirm DB migration rollback branch?
jia: I'll do Wave B (ingest & batching). Target 10:05 PT. Running e2e+load tests pre-deploy. Will flip feature flags if perf dips.
marta: Wave C (web + edge) — 10:30 PT works. Will watch Sentry + RUM. If frontend error rate >1% roll back.
sam: I have rollback branch 'rb/2026-03-17-release' ready. DB migration rollback not fully exercised — will run quick verify now.
liz: Thanks. @ops-bot create channel and scaffold runbook. Also include canaries: route 5% traffic post-deploy for 10m before full roll.
ops-bot: Created channel #release-2412345678-wave and scaffolded runbook at https://rwd.internal/runbooks/2412345678
sam: Running verification:
```
$ make rollback-smoke
DB rollback check: OK
Migration reverse dry-run: OK
Restore snapshot verify: OK
```
All green. :thumbsup:
jia: FYI I'll push a small DC capacity bump at T-15m to avoid queueing.
omar: Noted. I can deploy a hotfix if we see gateway 503s. @liz do you want staggered handover cadence (A -> B -> C) or parallel for 10m overlap?
liz: Let's do staggered A then B then C with 10m buffer between waves. That gives rollback margin. I'll post final schedule in #release-2412345678-wave. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
